summary: Frontend-only testing completed for Smart Stores POD qualification web app - Firebase integration working, found critical filter bug

integration_issues.issue: All status filters (Approved, Deposit Required, Not Qualified, High Risk) show the same submissions instead of filtering by status
integration_issues.details: Dashboard stats show correct counts (Total: 2, Approved: 2, Deposit: 0, Not Qualified: 0, High Risk: 0) but filters show 2 submissions for all filter types

design_issues.issue: Custom radio button components are difficult to interact with programmatically due to complex UI library implementation
design_issues.details: Radio buttons work visually but data-testid attributes don't match standard input elements

passed_tests: Customer form multi-step navigation (Steps 1-4 working perfectly)
Customer form field validation on required fields
Customer form input field functionality (all data-testid attributes working)
Firebase Auth integration for admin login
Admin login redirect to dashboard after successful authentication
Protected route functionality (redirects to login when not authenticated)
Admin dashboard stats display with correct Firebase data
Admin dashboard submission detail modal functionality
Admin dashboard modal score display and breakdown sections
Admin logout functionality with redirect to login
Firebase Firestore data retrieval and display
Scoring algorithm calculation (verified through existing test submissions)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical filter functionality bug in admin dashboard - filters are not properly filtering submissions by status despite stats showing correct counts. The issue appears to be in the firebaseApi.getSubmissions() method or filter logic.
